quarantined.reason: real-device JSEngine parse failure: SyntaxError missing } after property list

notes: Test12 is a storage-rescue + playback-protocol release. It removes Test11 from the active module chain, migrates settings/media cache/history/favorites/page-template state to rule-private files, and overrides hot-path HTML cache to memory-only. Bootstrap intentionally direct-loads this immutable release instead of Remote Manager state so an already saturated setItem store cannot block rescue startup. Strict no-sniff is strengthened with player_aaaa/player_data encrypt=1/2, parse/jx candidates, HTTP status/location/HLS detection and static decoding.
